blurb: Central Iowa Charters offers full charter services for RAGBRAI riders including transportation of riders, bikes, and luggage, reserved campsites, tent setup and teardown, showers, and charging stations. They also provide shuttle-only and luggage-only services. The service includes amenities such as a private shower trailer, beverage access, and e-bike charging for a fee.
extraNote: Full refund before June 1 with $25 processing fee · Transportation only registrations accepted after June 15, space permitting · Super Target parking lot, 2135 SE Delaware Ave, Ankeny, IA · July (RAGBRAI event week)
